note: Break A2: diagnostic rule (check counters, stated loudly) and remedy rule (bounce, stated tersely). Written by hand for break tests.

messages.author: Veikko Vikkelä
messages.text: New SFP in TRN-033, link up but no traffic. What do I look at?

messages.author: Erkki Expert
messages.text: Rule number one after ANY SFP swap on these boxes: always check the traffic counters first, every single time, before you do anything else. I can't stress this enough.

messages.author: Erkki Expert
messages.text: Then bounce the interface. No reboot.
